verdict: NOT SHIPPABLE — needs authored motion in the blend

cause.summary: shape, not scale — peak/mean is 2.96 against V1's 4.58
cause.jawIsHeadInherited: Jaw is parented to Head and holds a constant local rotation outside t=0.10..0.40, so its world rate equals the head's; Head therefore carries ~77% of the mean.

approachesMeasured.approach: uniform gain on every non-jaw, non-protected channel
approachesMeasured.verdict: rejected — 0.85x FAILS the p95 floor (3732 < 3799.8); best achievable worst-margin ~5.5%, and it only moves the thin margin from the mean channel to the p95 channel

approachesMeasured.approach: uniform gain on the PANEL_COUPLED set alone
approachesMeasured.verdict: rejected — a near no-op. The panels that hold the frame max are static AT BIND (excursion 0.0), so a gain about bind does nothing to them; their world motion is inherited from ancestors further up the chain.

approachesMeasured.approach: uniform gain on the head/neck chain (Neck1, Neck2, Head)
approachesMeasured.verdict: rejected — kills the peak. 3471 is below the 3830 floor because the peak IS the head.

approachesMeasured.approach: time-varying gain: 1.0 inside a window on the peak frame, bg outside, raised-cosine blend
approachesMeasured.verdict: REACHES THE TARGET AND IS STILL REJECTED — it injects angular velocity into the wing chain at every window edge, and the gate cannot see it.

whyRejected.mechanism: The wing is a 6-deep chain (Shoulder > Elbow > Wrist > Hand > Digit > Panel). A chain's composed angular velocity picks up a term proportional to the sum of the per-bone gain derivatives, so a gain that varies in time injects a jerk wherever it changes.
whyRejected.gateBlindness: measureClipDynamics takes the per-frame MAXIMUM rate across bones, so a rate rise reads as MORE energy and only improves the gate numbers. An instrument that rewards the artifact is the failure mode this project keeps measuring for.

safetyChecksThatDidPass: peak and p95 held exactly (4931 / 4391) at the peak-window variant
accelMax unchanged at the quiet-edges variant (144839)
zero channels ended further from bind than they started (all gains <= 1)
Jaw excluded outright, so the authored 32.0deg mouth is untouched and restore_jaw_amplitude.mjs still reads attack as a control clip
conclusion: attack needs authored motion in the blend — a sharper, more punctuated bite with a quieter anticipation and recovery. The 0.5% margin is a pass and is recorded as an open item rather than traded for a membrane jerk.
